caption: A man wearing a blue-and-white vertically striped shirt and a yellow tie holds an optical disc beside his face with one hand, its rainbow-reflective surface and printed label band facing the camera. He speaks directly toward the viewer while a space-themed poster and dark curtains remain fixed behind him, the camera essentially static. His free hand enters from the lower right with the index finger extended, pointing toward the printed outer edge of the disc. The finger hovers near the rim, shifting up and down along the label as if indicating different spots on it. Small tilts of the disc shift its rainbow reflections and the label band slightly. The pointing hand then drops out of view, leaving only the disc-holding hand in frame. His eyes blink or close intermittently and his head nods subtly as he continues talking.
